However, the company exhibits severe operational inefficiencies with a deeply negative operating income of -988M (operating margin of -42%), although net income remains positive at 644M due to non-operating items or tax adjustments. This significant divergence between weak operating profitability and strong balance sheet metrics places the credit profile in the lower investment-grade or high speculative-grade territory.

DECISION: BBB-
